notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.2.25 (Transition out of Early Access)
notes.content:
Release to transition out of Early Access

- Updated music
- Performance fixes
- Resolution fixes
- Removed Early Access Overlay 
- Fix card portraits

notes.title: v0.10.9.beta patch notes
notes.content:
- Picking items during fights and shop when you already have all items slots is not possible anymore.
- Added Hitodama and Cochinibi events & fights
- Added option to change custom deck name

notes.title: v0.8.27.beta patch notes
notes.content:
- Added custom decks. Now players have the choice to add their custom vocabulary, kanji and so on! For info on how to add and modify custom decks, you can follow this guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3318566471
- Fixes in the grammar deck display of some quizzes.

notes.title: v0.8.17.beta patch notes
notes.content:
From now on, concepts will be quizzed only once per quiz session. This means there will be less repeated quizzes!

Performing a quiz correctly will make it so that concept is displayed less. Note though, that having very few concepts will make them appear anyways, unless hibernated.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.7.26.beta

notes.title: v0.7.7.beta is out!
notes.content:
- Added voiceover to all examples, expressions, and quizzes.
- Now quiz shows the relevant concepts after completing a question
- Fixes for some grammar questions and expression formatting

notes.content:
- Fixed crash when fighting against Yokai with "Persist armor"

notes.title: Update notes for 20th of April 2024
notes.content:
- Added the following cards:
```
Armor Surge	Double your armor
Bash	Break all enemy armor
Bash+	Break all enemies armor
Eternal Guard	Persist armor between turns
Strike Guard	Deal 5 damage and gain 5 armor
Strike Guard+	Deal 8 damage and gain 8 armor
Samurai Tackle	Deal damage equal to your armor
Fortify	Add 4 fortified
Fortify+	Add 7 fortified
```
- Added Fortified modifier (Gain X armor at the end of each turn)
- Fixed modifiers to show when the player persists armor and fortify status
